title: Do You Have What It Takes to Be an Influencer? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Everyone wants to ditch corporate America for the content creator lifestyle these days... but it may not be as easy as it sounds. Jill and Mark break down the pros and cons of the creator economy — and all the ups and downs that come with it. Plus, what's all this drama about iced coffee in job interviews? Jill and Mark have the scoop — and lots more to say…
